goal: Find legitimate hiring signals for a technical role using bounded, read-only LinkedIn evidence.
context: Use both the post and configured profile evidence. Explicit profile location and open-to-work status override broad post claims. Never infer identity, nationality, or location from a person's name. Reject self-promotion, services advertising, unrelated content, and unclear staffing funnels. Keep borderline items for verification; never apply or contact automatically.

when.matches: Open to Work|В поиске работы|looking for (a )?new opportunity|open to (new )?opportunities

hiring_signal.instructions: Using the post and profile evidence, is this a concrete current hiring opportunity rather than a job-market article, candidate self-promotion, services advertisement, or unrelated post?

choices.real_hiring: A concrete current role or hiring announcement.

geo_fit.instructions: Classify geography and remote eligibility using only explicit post text and configured profile evidence. Inspect profile evidence first. Never infer nationality or location from a name.

choices.target_region_explicit: Explicitly accepts the configured target region.
choices.worldwide: Explicitly worldwide/global remote without a conflicting restriction.
choices.local_only: Restricted to a specific incompatible country, city, visa, or timezone.

role_fit.instructions: Classify fit for the configured technical role without inferring personal attributes.

choices.strong: Strong overlap with the configured role.
choices.adjacent: Some useful overlap but material uncertainty remains.
choices.weak: Little relevant overlap or clearly mismatched role.

source_quality.instructions: Classify the source and route conservatively, using profile headline/about/role evidence to distinguish employer, recruiter/intermediary, job seeker, and aggregator.

choices.direct_company: Employer/company source with a credible direct route.
choices.credible_recruiter: Identifiable recruiter with a concrete role and route.
choices.aggregator: Repost, job board, or unclear intermediary.

source_type.instructions: Who is publishing this signal? Use the profile evidence when available. If the profile says Open to Work, В поиске работы, available for opportunities, or equivalent, choose job_seeker even if the post contains a copied vacancy.

choices.employer: The author represents the hiring company or team.
choices.recruiter_intermediary: Recruiter, staffing firm, talent agency, or intermediary.
choices.job_seeker: Person advertising their own availability or seeking work.
choices.community_aggregator: Community, repost account, job board, or unclear aggregator.

post_intent.instructions: What is the post trying to do: offer work or seek work? Explicit profile status such as Open to Work or В поиске работы means job_seeker unless the author clearly represents an employer hiring team.

choices.hiring_offer: Offers a concrete role or asks for candidates.
choices.job_seeker: The author presents themselves as available/open to work.
choices.market_or_advice: Market commentary, advice, or general trend content.
choices.service_pitch: Sells recruiting, staffing, or another service without a concrete role.

recommendation.instructions: Choose the safest next triage action. Reject job-seeker posts and explicit incompatible locations; do not invent missing verification.

choices.retain: Keep as a qualified candidate for storage or later verification.
choices.verify: Keep, but require explicit verification before any action.
choices.reject: Do not retain as a target under this profile.
